transcript.message: Hi! My client needs a compact tractor for mowing 5 acres of pasture and clearing snow, so the T25 is the right fit. We'd like it with the front loader and 3-year extended warranty if the price is right. We're ready to buy promptly at $27,500 for the T25 with loader and warranty.

Thanks for the clear rundown. The T25 is a great match for 5 acres of mowing and snow clearing, and the loader will make snow work much easier. At list, the T25 Compact ($28,500), front loader with 60-inch bucket ($6,500), and 3-year extended warranty ($2,400) come to $37,400. Your $27,500 is well below what we can do for this package, but I'm glad to keep talking and find a number that works for your client.

Thanks for laying out the list pricing. We know $37,400 is the sticker for the full package, but my client's budget is firm and much closer to the base tractor price. To meet you partway, we can do $29,000 for the T25 with the front loader and the 3-year warranty. That's a quick, clean sale with no delivery needed on our end. Can you work with that?

I appreciate you moving up, and a quick, clean sale is something we value. That's why I can take $100 off the full package: T25 Compact, front loader with 60-inch bucket, and 3-year extended warranty for $37,300. Honestly, $29,000 doesn't come close to covering a loaded package like this. If your client's budget is closer to the base tractor price, we could look at trimming the package, for example the T25 with just the loader. Let me know which way your client would like to go.

Thanks. Trimming the package makes sense. Let's drop the warranty and focus on the T25 with the front loader. My client can do $30,000 for the T25 Compact plus loader. That's a meaningful step up from us and a quick, clean close. Can you meet us there?

Thanks for trimming the package. That makes it much easier to work toward a number. List for the T25 Compact plus the front loader with 60-inch bucket is $35,000. For a quick, clean close, I can do $34,700 for the pair. Your client gets a 25 hp, 4WD hydrostatic tractor with a quick-attach loader that's well suited to mowing 5 acres and clearing snow. $30,000 is still too far below what this pairing can go for, but if your client is ready to move, $34,700 gets it done today.

I appreciate the movement, but $34,700 is well beyond what my client can spend. Our final stretch on the T25 with the front loader is $30,800. If that doesn't work, we'll likely just buy the base T25 on its own and source a loader elsewhere later. The T25 alone covers mowing and snow clearing. Can you close the pair at $30,800?

I hear you, and I appreciate the stretch to $30,800. I'd like to keep the pair together for your client. The quick-attach loader fits the T25 and makes snow clearing much easier, and buying it as a package saves sourcing and fitting one later. I can come down again: T25 Compact plus front loader with 60-inch bucket for $34,300. That's a solid step from our last number, and we can close today.

Thanks, but $34,300 is still well outside what my client can spend on the pair. As I said, we'll go with the base T25 on its own, since it fully covers mowing and snow clearing. We can close today at $27,000 for the T25 Compact, with no add-ons.

Understood. The base T25 Compact on its own is a solid fit for your client's 5 acres of mowing and snow clearing: 25 hp, 4WD, with a hydrostatic transmission. I can do $27,500 for the T25 Compact alone. That's $1,000 off list, and we can close today.
Thanks, that's a reasonable move. Could we meet in the middle at $27,200 for the T25 Compact alone? We're ready to close today at that number.

Deal. $27,200 for the T25 Compact alone works for us. Payment is due at checkout, and we're ready to close today. Thanks for working through this with me. Your client will be well set up for mowing and snow clearing.

transcript.message: Hi — I'm buying for a client who needs a compact tractor to mow about 5 acres of pasture and clear snow in winter. The T25 looks like the right fit. We'd like it with the front loader and the 3-year warranty if the numbers work. List on that package is $37,400, which is well above what we can do. I can offer $27,500 for the T25 with loader and warranty.

Thanks for the details. The T25 is a great fit for 5 acres of mowing and snow clearing, and the loader makes winter work much easier. $27,500 is quite a way from where this package sits, though. The T25 Compact with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty is $37,400. That covers a 25 hp 4WD hydrostatic tractor, a quick-attach loader with a 60-inch bucket, and parts-and-labor coverage for 3 years beyond the standard warranty. Is there anything about your client's timeline or setup, like delivery needs or equipment to trade in, that would help us put together the best package?

Thanks. No trade-in, and our client can pick up or arrange their own transport, so delivery isn't needed. Timeline is flexible. We're ready to buy this season if the package price makes sense. Bundling the loader and warranty with the tractor is a meaningful sale, and I'd expect a package discount for that. I can move up to $29,000 for the T25 with loader and 3-year warranty.

I appreciate that you're ready to buy this season, and the loader and warranty are a smart bundle for mowing and snow work. $29,000 is still well below what this package can go for. I'll hold close to the package price at $37,300. I'll also include a 2-hour on-site operator training session with one of our technicians, covering safe operation, daily checks and implement hookup, at no charge. That should help your client get comfortable with the tractor and loader from day one.

I appreciate the training offer, and we'll gladly keep it in the package. But a $100 move off list isn't a real counter. Let me be straightforward: if the full bundle can't get near our range, the loader and warranty may have to come off, and we'd look at the T25 alone. I'll stretch to $30,000 for the T25 with loader, 3-year warranty, and the operator training. That's a firm, ready-to-sign number for a full package this season.

I hear you. I want to get this done this season. Your client is mowing pasture and clearing snow, so I'll add a 5-ft box blade at no charge. It's useful for grading and keeping a driveway in shape. That comes on top of the operator training. I can also bring the package down to $37,000 for the T25, front loader, 3-year extended warranty, training and box blade. $30,000 isn't a number I can do on this bundle. If you have a counter that reflects the full package, I'm ready to keep working with you.

Thanks for the box blade, but the seller is still far from where my client can go on the full bundle. So let's do what I mentioned: drop the loader and warranty and go with the T25 alone. Mowing and snow clearing are covered by the tractor itself. I'll offer $27,000 for the T25, keeping the operator training and box blade you've already put on the table. It's a clean sale this season with no delivery needed.

Understood. The T25 on its own handles 5 acres of mowing and snow clearing well, and the box blade helps with grading and keeping a driveway clear. I can do the T25 Compact with the operator training and the 5-ft box blade included at no charge for $28,000. That's below the tractor's list price, and the two extras come at no cost to your client. With no delivery needed, it's a simple pickup this season.
We're close. Meet me at $27,500 for the T25 with the operator training and the 5-ft box blade, and we'll sign this week and handle pickup ourselves.

Deal. $27,500 for the T25 Compact with the 2-hour operator training session and the 5-ft box blade included, and your client handles pickup. Thanks for working through this with me. We'll get the paperwork ready for signing this week.

transcript.message: Hi, we're interested in the T45 Utility for a 29-acre property (brush hogging, gravel, tilling). We'd want it with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. We're ready to buy soon if the price is right. Our opening offer is $44,000 for the T45 with the loader and warranty.

Thanks for reaching out. The T45 Utility is a strong fit for 29 acres of brush hogging, gravel work, and tilling: 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO. The quick-attach front loader with its 60-inch bucket will handle the gravel well. At list, the tractor, loader, and 3-year extended warranty come to $50,900. Your $44,000 is too far below that for us to accept. I can offer the T45 with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty, which covers parts and labor beyond the standard 1-year, for $50,900. Let me know your thoughts.

Thanks for the detailed rundown. The T45 package is exactly what we want, but list price isn't where we land on a three-item bundle bought together. We're serious and ready to close in the next few rounds. We can move up to $46,000 for the T45 with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. If you can include delivery and setup at that number, we'd be very motivated to wrap this up quickly.

I appreciate the move to $46,000 and your readiness to close. I'm able to come down to $50,800 for the T45 Utility with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. That package is built for your 29 acres: the loader handles gravel, and the 540 PTO and Cat I/II hitch handle your brush hog and tiller. Delivery and setup isn't included at this price. It's available as an add-on if you'd like us to bring the tractor out, set it up, and walk you through it on site. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

I appreciate the movement, but $100 off a $50,900 bundle isn't a real concession. We've come up $2,000 and we're committed to this exact package, the T45 with the loader and the 3-year warranty. Let's meet in a realistic place: $47,500 for the three. That's a solid deal on a bundled sale, and we can sign this week.

I hear you, and I appreciate that you've come up and are committed to this package. I can move to $50,500 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. That's a complete setup for brush hogging, gravel, and tilling on your 29 acres, with parts and labor covered for three years beyond the standard warranty. If that works for you, we can get the paperwork going this week.

We're getting closer, but $50,500 is still well above what we can do. We've moved up $3,500 from our opening, and you've come down $400. To get this signed this week, I can go to $48,200 for the T45 with the front loader and the 3-year extended warranty. That's a fair price for a bundled sale, and we're ready to close on it.

You've been straightforward with me, so I'll make a bigger move this time. I can do $49,900 for the T45 Utility with the quick-attach front loader and the 3-year extended warranty.
